CVE-2023-99999 — Android WebView Remote Code Execution

A critical vulnerability in Android WebView allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted web page. All Android versions prior to 13.0.0.1 are affected.

Overview

This advisory describes a critical vulnerability affecting Android WebView component versions before 113.0.5672.77.

Affected Products

  • Android WebView < 113.0.5672.77
  • Android 10, 11, 12, 13 (all versions before patch)

Mitigation

Update Android WebView to version 113.0.5672.77 or later via Google Play Store. Apply the June 2023 Android Security Bulletin updates immediately.

References

  • Android Security Bulletin June 2023
